== [[Feedback:Game updates/20120913|September 13, 2012]] ==

* Now causes 5 points of Overcast.
* Changed functionality to: "Target foe is struck for 15...75 cold damage. If that foe has a Water Magic hex, Icy Prism deals +15...75 cold damage to all other nearby foes."
